title: hive-route agents, format 1: agents that ask the route service for a model at each episode (ROUTING.md §9.2)

token_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the agent's bearer token. The agent holds the token; this file holds only its hash.

kinds.description: The kinds the agent may ask for; the first is the default.

facts.description: Facts fixed for the agent, as in a request (request-v1.schema.json), without kind: what's at stake in its role. The agent can't change them.

runner_token_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the token of the agent's runner: a trusted component outside the agent (e.g. the process that admits its requests and grants their tools). With it, /route may also state runner_facts.

runner_facts.description: Facts only the runner may state per episode, e.g. consequence from the tools it grants the episode. Requires runner_token_sha256; a fact here can't also be fixed.

ignore_models.description: Names (glob patterns) an episode's report may contain that aren't models, e.g. a gateway's agent target (openclaw/*). Never drift.

text_facts.description: Facts the request's text may state, on a line `Route facts: key=value ...` (the convention of 1-hive's orders): for agents whose tasks come from a record whose orders carry them. A fact here can't also be fixed; the line's other keys are ignored.

episode_facts.description: Facts the agent may state per episode (default: specification and scope). A fact in both lists is an error.

failure_policy.description: Overrides for what /episodes/failure answers this agent (ROUTING.md §9.4); unset keys take the defaults.

transport_retries.description: Retries of the same model after a provider error (default 1).

long_step_retries.description: Retries, in parts, of a step that ran long (default 1).

long_step_seconds.description: A server error after running this long is a long step, not an outage (default 120).

capacity_wait_max_s.description: A rate limit whose Retry-After is at most this is waited out once (default 120).

backoff_s.description: Wait before the first transport retry; doubles per retry (default 15).

down_minutes.description: How long a pool counts at its limit when the provider doesn't say (default 30).

author.description: For an agent that only reviews: the author's family and tier (RT4).
